headline: Peruvian economy grew 2.43% in September; shows slowdown
summary: Peru's economy expanded 2.43% year on year in September, according to the National Statistics and Informatics Institute, slowing from 3.23% growth in the prior month.
why: Gross domestic product growth is the main indicator of economic activity, and Peru is a major copper, gold and zinc producer whose growth influences regional investment.
original_headline: Economía peruana creció 2.43% en septiembre; registra desaceleración
